root_cause.text: The `nx-842` driver incorrectly releases multi-page bounce buffers (allocated with `__get_free_pages()` at order `BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER`) using `free_page()` instead of `free_pages()` with the matching order, resulting in a memory leak of the remaining pages.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in both `nx842_crypto_alloc_ctx` and `nx842_crypto_free_ctx` in `drivers/crypto/nx/nx-842.c`, calls to `free_page((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce)` and `free_page((unsigned long)ctx->dbounce)` are replaced with `free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER)` and `free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->dbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER)`.
